# vastdata_de_trace_tree (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
# Inspect the root trace and function spans for a specific `trace_id`.
# Can be chained directly from `data.vastdata_de_traces` to inspect the latest execution.
data "vastdata_de_traces" "recent" {
  tenant_name   = "de-lab"
  pipeline_name = "my-pipeline"
  limit         = 1
  order_by      = "desc"
}

data "vastdata_de_trace_tree" "example" {
  tenant_name = "de-lab"
  trace_id    = data.vastdata_de_traces.recent.data[0].trace_id
}

output "root_trace" {
  value = data.vastdata_de_trace_tree.example.root_trace
}

output "trace_functions" {
  value = data.vastdata_de_trace_tree.example.functions
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `trace_id` (String)

### Optional

- `tenant_name` (String) Tenant name for Data Engine API queries. Required for cluster-admin auth; optional when the provider already authenticates as that tenant.

### Read-Only

- `functions` (Attributes Set) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--functions))
- `root_trace` (Attributes) Extended TraceResult used as root_trace in the trace-tree response. Inherits from RootTrace so that linked_from and links_to are arrays of full Trace objects (not just IDs), giving the caller all necessary context about related traces in a single response. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--root_trace))

<a id="nestedatt--functions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `functions`

Read-Only:

- `value` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--functions--value))

<a id="nestedatt--functions--value"></a>
### Nested Schema for `functions.value`

Read-Only:

- `attached_trace_id` (String) Trace ID this span is attached to for filtering purposes
- `end_time` (Number) End time of the Span since epoch in micro sec
- `error` (Attributes) Error that occurred during the Trace/Span (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--functions--value--error))
- `event` (Attributes) CloudEvent compatible event that triggered the Pipeline or Function (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--functions--value--event))
- `links` (Set of String) OTEL Span links — the canonical OpenTelemetry `Span.links` field (see https://opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/otel/trace/api/#specifying-links). Carries trace IDs this span is causally linked to across trace boundaries. In our pipeline this is the INPUT signal: a batch span emits one OTEL Link per processed event (set by the runtime via `tracer.start_as_current_span(links=...)`), collected as-is by the telemetries-collector, and consumed by the traces-aggregator to deduce `trace_type=Batch` and to populate the `AggregatedTracesLinks` table (batch→event forward references). NOTE: this is distinct from any aggregated `links_to`/`linked_from` fields on Trace, which are derived from this OTEL signal at aggregation time.
- `parent_span_id` (String) ID of the parent Span. Empty if this is the root Span
- `resource` (Attributes) Resource producing the telemetry, as in OTEL specification (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--functions--value--resource))
- `scope` (String)
- `span_id` (String) ID of the Span
- `span_name` (String) Name of the Span (i.e. function name, request URL)
- `span_status` (String)
- `span_type` (String) Type of the span (e.g. 'event', 'batch', 'init')
- `start_time` (Number) Start time of the Span since epoch in micro sec
- `trace_id` (String) ID of the Trace this Span is associated with

Read-Only:

- `error_escaped` (Boolean) Whether the error was thrown or not
- `error_message` (String) Message describing the error
- `error_stacktrace` (String) Shows the stack of frames leading to the error
- `error_type` (String) Type of the error (Exception class in Python)

<a id="nestedatt--root_trace"></a>
### Nested Schema for `root_trace`

Read-Only:

- `end_time` (Number) End time of the Trace since epoch in micro sec
- `event` (Attributes) CloudEvent compatible event that triggered the Pipeline or Function (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--root_trace--event))
- `linked_from` (Attributes Set) Full Trace objects for each trace that links TO this trace (reverse direction of links_to). For event traces, these are the batch traces created from this event. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--root_trace--linked_from))
- `links_to` (Attributes Set) Full Trace objects for the traces this trace links TO. For batch traces, these are the event traces that originated this batch. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--root_trace--links_to))
- `resource` (Attributes) Resource producing the telemetry, as in OTEL specification (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--root_trace--resource))
- `start_time` (Number) Start time of the Trace since epoch in micro sec
- `status` (String) Status of the Trace
- `trace_id` (String) ID of the Trace
- `trace_type` (String) Type of trace (init, batch, or event)

<a id="nestedatt--root_trace--linked_from"></a>
### Nested Schema for `root_trace.linked_from`

Read-Only:

- `end_time` (Number) End time of the Trace since epoch in micro sec
- `event` (Attributes) CloudEvent compatible event that triggered the Pipeline or Function (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--root_trace--linked_from--event))
- `linked_from` (Set of String) a reverse direction of the "links_to" field of adjacent trace. For event traces, this contains the batch trace IDs that WERE CREATED FROM this event (i.e. event→batch links resolved via the AggregatedTracesLinks table).
- `links_to` (Set of String) Trace IDs that this trace links TO. For batch traces, this contains the event trace IDs that ORIGINATED this batch and were processed as part of the batch execution (i.e. batch→event forward references written at aggregation time).
- `resource` (Attributes) Resource producing the telemetry, as in OTEL specification (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--root_trace--linked_from--resource))
- `start_time` (Number) Start time of the Trace since epoch in micro sec
- `status` (String) Status of the Trace
